name: LBMlink
description: Link class for Lattice Boltzmann Method

attributes.name: DistMid
attributes.description: Distance between middle of the link and mass center of body

attributes.name: PointingOutside
attributes.description: True if it is a link pointing outside to the system (from a fluid or solid node)

attributes.name: ct
attributes.description: Coupling term in modified bounce back rule

attributes.name: isBd
attributes.description: True if it is a boundary link

attributes.name: nid2
attributes.description: fixed node identifier or -1 if node points outside
